scope: Read-only comparison of the normal GWG coding-plug date block at 0x1020 with GFA P103-P105.

gwg_main_regulation.interpretation: The source-defined date slots do not contain a valid calendar day/month triplet on this active plug. Exact vendor sentinel semantics for FF are not claimed.

comparison.result: GWG and GFA coding-plug date views are separate datasets on this appliance.
comparison.consequence: The earlier plan to use 0x1020 to choose between direct-integer and BCD interpretation of P103-P105 is rejected.

gfa_date_status.source_labels: P103 day, P104 month, P105 year
gfa_date_status.status: calendar display/year base still unresolved independently of 0x1020

physical_spare_chip1_context.note: This remains only weak correlation because the spares are different plug instances and the saved chip1 side is not physically labelled f01/f02.
